_comment: Alt text and viewer captions for the About page photo strip, keyed by source filename. A plain string is just the caption; an object can also carry an explicit square crop for the thumbnail, given as fractions of the upright image (side is a fraction of the shorter edge). Without a crop the thumbnail is framed automatically, which works for most photos but chases brightness. These captions were written from the photographs - correct any that name the wrong process.
